plain: Either a model whose inner workings we cannot read, or an attack that only sends inputs and reads outputs.
eli5: A toy that works but you cannot open, or a game where you can only press buttons and watch.
technical: Two senses: in interpretability, a model treated as opaque, whose internal computation is not understood; in red teaming, an attack that needs only query access (as through an API) and no weights or gradients, the opposite of a white-box attack.
